meta.notes: The element id names the language: en_us is English (US); add de_de, fr_fr and so on next to it. Keys are free text, but the game builds item.<namespace>.<name> and block.<namespace>.<name> keys itself. %s marks a value filled in by the text component that uses the key, for example tellraw @s {"translate":"msm_examples.message.welcome","with":["Alex"]}. Any language file may also override vanilla keys, here the emerald's name.
